title: TriadicFrameworks MCP — Lineage Tracing Tool
description: Traces cosmological, structural, and resonance lineage for entities within the Frequency Layer (Unseen). Produces ancestry chains from qmroot → triad → diagnostic/operator.
note: Students may rename qmroot if extending the work; it is a lineage artifact for TriadicFrameworks and RTT.

tool.name: traceLineage
tool.purpose: Trace the lineage chain of an entity from qmroot ancestry through triad inheritance to diagnostic/operator identity.

entity.description: Name or ID of the entity whose lineage should be traced (e.g., clarity, coherence, harmonic, oscillation).

includeMetadata.description: Whether to include extended lineage metadata.

ancestry.description: Ordered lineage chain from qmroot → triad → entity.

origin.description: Primary cosmological origin (always qmroot-0D for Frequency Layer entities).

metadata.description: Extended lineage metadata returned only if includeMetadata=true.
Coherence inherits its cosmological origin from qmroot-0D and its structural identity from the frequency triad.

reality.details: Lineage is resolved using entity → ancestry mapping rules.

imagination.details: The unseen resonance field reveals the ancestry chain that gives the entity its identity.

information.details: Lineage tracing inherits qmroot-0D and triad-frequency metadata for cosmological consistency.
